title: The Forest Find: Stacy's Metal Detecting Adventure
style_guide: Realistic, low-quality, 360p JPEG look, handheld phone photos, natural colors, no cinematic effects

scenes.narration: Thirteen-year-old Stacy loved metal detecting, inspired by her grandfather.
scenes.visual: A young girl holding a metal detector on a forest trail, trees around, casual clothing, natural light.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic photo of a young girl with a metal detector in a forest, low resolution, JPEG style, handheld shot

scenes.narration: One day, she went into the forest near a big oak tree, since the beach was closed.
scenes.visual: A large oak tree with fallen leaves at its base, girl with detector nearby, overcast sky, casual wear.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-quality photo of an oak tree and girl with metal detector, natural colors, JPEG look, handheld photo

scenes.narration: She found some small metal objects and bullet shells first.
scenes.visual: Close-up of the ground showing scattered small metal items and shells, dirt and leaves, muddy surface.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic, blurry photo of dirt with small metal objects and shells, JPEG style, handheld shot

scenes.narration: Then, her detector signaled again and she uncovered a big silver coin.
scenes.visual: Girl kneeling with metal detector, holding a large shiny coin, forest background, casual clothing.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-quality photo of girl holding a shiny coin, forest background, JPEG, handheld shot

scenes.narration: The coin had an unusual crest engraved on it.
scenes.visual: Close-up of the silver coin showing detailed engraving, minimal background, dull natural light.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic, blurry photo of silver coin with crest, JPEG style, handheld shot

scenes.narration: Excited, she took photos and shared her discovery online.
scenes.visual: Girl holding phone, taking a picture of the coin, dirt ground, forest setting, casual morning light.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-res photo of girl taking picture with phone, outdoor forest, JPEG look, handheld

scenes.narration: Within hours, her post went viral, attracting many comments.
scenes.visual: Screenshot of her social media post showing the coin picture and some comments, low detail.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic, low-quality screenshot of social media post and comments, JPEG style

scenes.narration: One anonymous user offered to buy the coin and asked her to delete the post.
scenes.visual: Typed comment on her social media, with a private message notification, informal font, casual setting.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-res image of a social media comment with private message, JPEG, handheld

scenes.narration: Soon, the photo disappeared mysteriously from her account.
scenes.visual: Screen showing the vanished post, blank space where it was, low-resolution social media interface.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-quality screen image of missing social media post, JPEG style, handheld

scenes.narration: Next morning, police arrived at her house with questions.
scenes.visual: Police cars outside a modest house, officers talking to a girl and her mother in the yard, natural colors.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic photo of police cars outside house, officers speaking with family, low quality, handheld shot
